name: San Román de la Cuba (Spain)
description: Quartered red and white above and yellow and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Román de la Cuba (a tower and a shell on red above an ear of wheat on green).
history: The flag was approved and published at the same time as the arms; it is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, quartered by a cross, the first quarter red, the second white, the third yellow and the fourth green, with the crowned arms of the town in its colours at the centre, of a height equal to 1/2 of the width of the flag.

features.role: San Román de la Cuba arms — tower and shell on red above an ear of wheat on green
